author: Italo Calvino
chinese: 然而这城不会泄露它的过去，只会把它像掌纹一样藏起来，写在街角、在窗格子里、在楼梯的扶手上、在避雷针的天线上、在旗杆上，每个环节依次呈现抓花的痕迹、刻凿的痕迹、涂鸦的痕迹。
english:
The city, however, does not reveal its past, but hides it
like the lines of a palm, inscribed on street corners,
on window frames, on stair railings, on lightning rod antennas,
and on flagpoles, each segment bearing in turn the marks
of scratches, gouges, and graffiti.
